top_signal.title: ADVICE NEEDED: How to find customers for temporary custom ring business?
top_signal.summary: I’m currently living in China until December, and I recently started a little side business helping people in the U.S. get custom jewelry made here for significantly less than they’d pay anywhere in the U.S.   It started when I lost my wedding ring and decided to have a replacement custom-made here in China. It turned out beautifully, and I was honestly shocked by how inexpensive it was, considering a similar ring would have cost multiple times more in the U.S. (the new ring was 300$, while the original was over $3000, and they are exactly the same ring). After that, I started helping a few friends get their own rings made here too, and they all turned out really well.   Now I’m thinking I’d love to offer this to more people! I think I’m in a particularly good position to do this because even Chinese custom jewelers who work with customers in the U.S. charge significant markups. I can personally coordinate with the jewelers for a much cheaper price, and I’m moving back to the U.S. in December, so I could also bring the finished rings back with me and avoid the expensive international shipping costs.   My problem is that I have absolutely no idea how to find customers for something this niche, especially with such a limited timeframe. I know there are many people who, like me, would love to get a high-quality engagement ring / wedding band or other piece of jewelry for the cheapest price possible.
